description: V1000: compact vector control AC drive (CIMR-VC), 0.1 to 18.5 kW. MEMOBUS/Modbus RTU slave over RS-422/RS-485; it has no Modbus TCP: a TCP/RTU gateway is needed. This file holds the communications command and monitor data (status, measurements, faults and alarms) and the drive parameter list (groups A to o) with its U monitors, named as in the manual.
source: Yaskawa, manual técnico del V1000 (SIEP C710606 19B): apéndice C «MEMOBUS/Modbus Communications», páginas 416-426 (mando, monitores y códigos de alarma) y apéndice B «Parameter List», páginas 331-376 (cada parámetro con su dirección, columna «Addr. Hex»). La dirección es la del manual (0020H = 0x0020 en la trama). La tabla del apéndice B se ha sacado del PDF con un programa: la dirección de cada fila se ha leído de dos formas y se ha comprobado que no se repite; el nombre, la escala y la unidad se deducen del texto y pueden estar mal en alguna fila. Fuera: E4-15 y U4-21 (el manual les da la dirección de la fila anterior), el autoajuste (T1), DriveWorksEZ (q, r, U8) y los rangos reservados. Sin probar en un equipo real.

save.description: Enter command: saves the parameters to EEPROM

protocol.restoreNotes: Restore with the drive stopped. With H5-11 = 0, written values only take effect with the Enter command (0900H = 0, which also saves them to EEPROM; it is sent at the end; wait 5 s before removing power); with H5-11 = 1 (default) they take effect when written and Enter saves them. The EEPROM allows 100,000 writes at most. Not restored: passwords and access level (A1-03 to A1-06, A2), communications (H5: it would cut Modbus; default slave 1FH, 9600 bps, no parity), drive model (o2-04), user defaults (o2-03), copy function (o3) and maintenance counters (o4). Motor data (E2, E4, E5) belong to the motor: on another motor, run Auto-Tuning. Many parameters depend on others (A1-02, the control method, changes several defaults; o1-03 and C1-10 change units): restore to a drive of the same model and capacity. Values are stored raw: a wrong scale in this file only affects how they are shown.
